dialogues.speaker: Koloman
dialogues.text: ...Yeah. That wasn't a good way to make a living, either. Used to think that life was all about having a thrill. Easy to think that, until a comrade dies before your eyes... Never mind. The past should stay in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Koloman
dialogues.text: Nowadays, all I want to do is live with my family in peace.
